collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — GOOD, BAD AND ORDINARY DAYS (DAY-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Wonderful days, rotten days, mixed days and days when nothing much happens at all. Moods come without reasons, small things matter more than they should, and nobody has to end the day happier, wiser or more productive than they started it.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)
the owner (2026-11-15): a person named by a role word is a cast villager and shows the name (flavor only: the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: People keep being kind to a villager in small ways for no clear reason: ask a friend why, or just accept it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Today, a lot of people have been kind to (subject), in small ways. Someone saved (subject.him/her) the best piece of fish. Someone refilled (subject.his/her) water jar without being asked. (child), a child, gave (subject.him/her) a flower. (subject) hasn't done anything special. (subject.He/she) isn't sick, or sad, or celebrating. (subject.He/she) is starting to feel slightly confused about it.

text_only.reason: a celebration or a happy feeling in the story; no celebration happens in the game -- the draft's notes: everything but the marked effects is story only

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "Why is everyone being so nice to me today?" asks (subject). (friend) looks blank. "Are they?" (subject) lists it all. (friend) shrugs. "Maybe it's just your turn." (subject) thinks about this. It's a nice idea: that the kindness goes round, and today it landed on (subject.him/her). (subject.He/she) decides to pass some on tomorrow.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (subject) stops wondering and simply accepts it. (subject.He/she) eats the fish. (subject.He/she) drinks the water. (subject.He/she) puts the flower behind (subject.his/her) ear. It's been a lovely day, for no reason, from lots of people, and (subject.he/she) goes to bed feeling warm all the way through.
